trai_reference.note: Reference values: TRAI's 2024 QoS regulations for wireline broadband (latency under 50 ms, jitter under 40 ms, from 1 Oct 2024, as reported by MediaNama); TRAI also moved to percentile-based reporting. note: Delay = reply time of small UDP packets (DNS queries to the public resolvers 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8 and 9.9.9.9, 10 a second in a steady stream, like a call or a game) while the load runs.
